android.desc:
Intenty - Mindful Phone Use Without App Blockers and Screen Time Limits

The dumbphone alternative that actually works.

Stop fighting your phone with screen time limits and app blockers. Start questioning why you reach for it. Intenty places thoughtful nudges between you and your screen, right at unlock, when autopilot kicks in.

Just one thoughtful pause that makes mindless scrolling almost impossible.

🧠 How Nudges Work

Nudges are awareness prompts that appear when you unlock your phone.

Right when you unlock, a question appears on your screen. You engage with it. Then you proceed.

That's the entire mechanism.

Yet this tiny interruption does what app blockers can't: it catches you in the exact moment habit takes over, turning automatic reflex into conscious choice.

One question. Couple of seconds. Changes everything.

🎯 8 Research-Backed Nudge Types

Intentional - Name your purpose before proceeding

Essential - "Is this necessary right now?" (Yes/No)

Readiness - “Pre-flight” mental checklist

Digital Detox - Gentle reminder during screen-free time

Back to Reality - Mid-session check-in after 5 minutes of use

Focus Gate - Protects deep work from interruptions

Slow Down - Mandatory 10-second breathing pause

Opportunity Cost - Makes the tradeoff visible

Plus unlimited custom nudges with your own prompts.

⚙️ Complete Control Over Your Experience

Schedule nudges around your routine. Adjust how frequently they appear. Control timing and pacing. Set up personal reflections that resurface when you need them. Enable hard mode when you want commitment.

Fine-tune every aspect until the friction feels natural, not annoying.

🎨 Minimalist by Design

Full-screen awareness prompts. Clean interface. Zero gamification, no screen time anxiety.

Maximum impact. Zero cognitive overhead.

🔒 100% Local & Private

All nudges and data stay on your device. No cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking, no accounts.

Your phone usage patterns never leave your device. Export data anytime.

💡 Why Awareness Beats Blocking

App blockers create resistance. Nudges create consciousness.

Phone addiction stems from unconscious checking, not conscious decisions. Digital minimalism isn't about using your phone less by force; it's about using it intentionally.

Intenty doesn't restrict access. It makes automatic behavior visible.

Perfect for: 

✓ Reduced phone checking without restrictive app blockers
✓ Dumbpho
